content.short: DeFi Prime provides analytics and digital media services for the DeFi community.
content.description: Founded in 2019 by Nick Sawinth, DeFi Prime delivers analytics and digital media services to inform and educate the DeFi community about the best offerings in decentralized finance. DeFi Prime curates existing products, spotlighting tools that enjoy the strongest popularity and traction in the space. Drawing on extensive experience as one of the oldest outlets dedicated to DeFi and open finance, DeFi Prime aims to showcase the top innovations and opportunities that DeFi has to offer.
